name: tipatask-pi-bundle
description: Self-contained node_modules tree for the Pi coding agent CLI, staged by scripts/stage-pi-bundle.js and shipped into packaged builds via electron-builder extraResources (C1112). Kept separate from the main dependency tree because it ships as plain files under Resources/pi/node_modules, not inside app.asar — @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent is pure ESM with its own dependency closure, and electron-builder never packages node_modules/.bin or bin/** anyway.
